name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL used to build links (e.g. the password reset link) falls back to `http://localhost:3000` when the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set. In production this env var appears to be missing/misconfigured, so reset and other emailed links point to localhost instead of the real public host. Fix by ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is set correctly in the production environment, and consider failing loudly (or using a sensible production default) instead of silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email falling back to localhost URL in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL is defined as `process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"`, so whenever PUBLIC_URL is unset or not populated in the deployed environment, password reset links (and the rollup/export links) silently fall back to localhost. This matches the reported bug: reset emails link to http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=... in production.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is required/validated at startup (e.g. via the config module) rather than silently defaulting to localhost, or source BASE_URL from a validated config value (such as config.publicUrl) that fails fast if missing in production. This prevents the localhost fallback from ever reaching real users while still allowing a localhost default for local development/testing.
